game_title: Strip And Replace – Cloud Sea Overlook Rush
game_concept: A action puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Cloud Sea Overlook, an overlook above the clouds: the avalanche scout must handle yetis while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Strip And Replace: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it.
theme: Frost Peaks – Cloud Sea Overlook: an overlook above the clouds
core_gameplay_loop: In Cloud Sea Overlook, repeat each round: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it. Each round, a new oxygen tanks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the clean_text value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 550 points of oxygen tanks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 550, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 9 (extended tier): Strip And Replace
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Strip And Replace' (Week 8 slot 14), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Cloud Sea Overlook'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how clean_text changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yetis in Cloud Sea Overlook.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 550 within 43 seconds.
